blocker_classes.trigger: CLI final message exists but required headings are missing or shallow.
retry_ladder: Add standalone exact-heading template to next prompt.
Dry-generate prompt and assert standalone headings.
Lower ambiguity by showing one numbered placeholder under each heading.
Run CLI quality gate with status-only counts and hashes.
If still open, keep as structure repair and request exact prompt/runner approval only if needed.

blocker_classes.trigger: Generic sensitive marker counts appear in final-message metadata.
retry_ladder: Run strict path/key/private-material quality gate.
Separate generic sensitive vocabulary from strict markers.
Publish only marker counts, hashes, bytes, and status.
Treat strict marker count zero as false-positive class, not raw publish clearance.
If strict markers appear, block summary and request exact review packet.

blocker_classes.trigger: App lane watcher has not produced completion receipt.
retry_ladder: Check cadence gate first.
Use gate-only app notifier receipt, not raw transport.
Record app lane open gaps by lane/status only.
Route repeated wait into stale-flow refresh.
If route is unavailable, publish blocker receipt and continue other approved work.
Fetch remote branch.
Inspect drift count.
If behind, pause publication and inspect changed curated paths.
Rebase/reset is not allowed without exact approval; prefer safe merge planning or pause.
Publish only after drift returns to zero or an approved resolution exists.

blocker_classes.trigger: Artifact language implies final GMUT, physics, consciousness, or canon closure.
retry_ladder: Run no-overclaim guard.
Replace closure claims with open-gate wording.
Add claim_boundary fields.
Re-run guard across generated artifacts.
If unresolved, block publication of the affected artifact.
Run publication provenance receipt helper.
Use repo-relative subject paths only.
Include material hashes where available.
Record local head, remote head, and drift.
If any subject is missing, block provenance claim and repair subject list.

blocker_classes.trigger: Task proposes plugin-cache or user-skill mutation without exact approval.
retry_ladder: Downgrade to repo-scoped skill candidate artifact.
Record live mutation false.
Add approval-packet requirement.
Keep plugin-cache/user-skill files untouched.
If live mutation is essential, pause for exact packet.

x2_use: Use this playbook during v497 v4 x2 build/run/test/use work and future v497 v5-v8 x1/x2 phases.
